e82d84cd510e127ea76cb153a175d44ad12d761f.summary: Doron Karmi's write-up of three Konni malware campaigns observed in 2019 (January to late September). Macro-armed lure Word documents run certutil to fetch later stages, which bypass UAC, persist through the COMSysApp service, and exfiltrate data over a free FTP service. Konni is potentially linked to APT37, a North Korean espionage group. A possible overlap with the Syscon backdoor was noted but not confirmed.

e82ccde24b5b3aca43b34b4bee23e8cb83b9cc91.summary: The Register reports FireEye research on a hacking group dubbed NOTROBIN that exploits the Citrix NetScaler flaw CVE-2019-19781 to compromise VPN gateways. After gaining access, the group removes existing malware and cryptocurrency miners, installs a backdoor reachable with a secret passphrase, and blocks other attackers from exploiting the flaw. FireEye believes the actor may be collecting access for a later campaign. The page also carries unrelated news items, which were not recorded.
